chunks.head: show off
chunks.note: 常含贬义,指故意表现以博取注意;本章反复出现,是全章的关键词
chunks.ex_en: He likes to show off his new bike to his friends.
chunks.ex_cn: 他喜欢向朋友炫耀他的新自行车。

chunks.head: turn out to be
chunks.note: 表示事情最终显露出的真实情况

literal.note_cn: 此处非"转动",构成"结果变成"义

chunks.ex_en: The new student turned out to be very friendly.
chunks.ex_cn: 那个新来的同学原来非常友好。

chunks.head: set out for
chunks.note: set out = 出发、启程,后接 for + 目的地
chunks.ex_en: We set out for the beach early in the morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们一大早就动身去海滩。

chunks.head: go on doing sth
chunks.note: go on + 动词ing 表示接着做同一件事
chunks.ex_en: She went on reading after dinner.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭后她继续看书。

chunks.head: stick to
chunks.note: 指不放弃、坚持某计划/工作/观点
chunks.ex_en: You should stick to your plan.
chunks.ex_cn: 你应该坚持你的计划。

chunks.head: bring up
chunks.note: 指养育孩子长大;另也可指"提出(话题)"
chunks.ex_en: Her grandparents brought her up in the countryside.
chunks.ex_cn: 她的祖父母在乡下把她抚养长大。

chunks.head: get around
chunks.note: 本章义为"避开、绕过(难题/事实)";常用 there's no getting around it
chunks.ex_en: There is no way to get around this rule.
chunks.ex_cn: 没有办法回避这条规定。

chunks.head: lose one's temper
chunks.note: 指一时失去情绪控制
chunks.ex_en: Try not to lose your temper with the kids.
chunks.ex_cn: 尽量不要对孩子们发脾气。

chunks.head: change hands
chunks.note: 指所有权从一个人转到另一个人
chunks.ex_en: The old shop has changed hands twice this year.
chunks.ex_cn: 这家老店今年已经转手两次了。

chunks.head: on the spot
chunks.note: 指就在事情发生的现场或那一刻
chunks.ex_en: The police arrived and arrested him on the spot.
chunks.ex_cn: 警察赶到,当场把他逮捕了。

chunks.head: in due course
chunks.note: 指经过应有的过程后、时机成熟时
chunks.ex_en: You will receive your results in due course.
chunks.ex_cn: 你会在适当的时候收到成绩。

chunks.head: more or less
chunks.note: 表示大致如此、几乎
chunks.ex_en: The work is more or less finished.
chunks.ex_cn: 工作差不多完成了。

chunks.head: far and wide
chunks.note: 指范围广、四面八方
chunks.ex_en: People came from far and wide to see the festival.
chunks.ex_cn: 人们从四面八方赶来看这个节日。

chunks.head: at heart
chunks.note: 指抛开外表看真实的性情
chunks.ex_en: He seems tough, but he is kind at heart.
chunks.ex_cn: 他看起来很强硬,但内心很善良。

chunks.head: a snake in the grass
chunks.note: 比喻表面友好、暗中害人的伪君子
chunks.ex_en: Be careful of him—he's a snake in the grass.
chunks.ex_cn: 小心他——他是个笑里藏刀的阴险小人。

chunks.head: all along
chunks.note: 指从头到尾、一贯如此
chunks.ex_en: I knew the truth all along.
chunks.ex_cn: 我自始至终都知道真相。

chunks.head: in a word
chunks.note: 用于概括、下结论
chunks.ex_en: In a word, the trip was a great success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总之,这次旅行非常成功。

chunks.head: make faces
chunks.note: 指扭曲脸部做怪相
chunks.ex_en: The children made faces at each other and laughed.
chunks.ex_cn: 孩子们互相做鬼脸,笑个不停。

chunks.head: with all one's might
chunks.note: 强调使出全身力气
chunks.ex_en: He pulled the rope with all his might.
chunks.ex_cn: 他用尽全力拉绳子。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: 引出目的,后接动词原形
chunks.ex_en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
chunks.ex_cn: 她努力学习以便通过考试。

chunks.head: be fond of
chunks.note: 表示对某人/某物有喜爱之情
chunks.ex_en: My sister is fond of animals.
chunks.ex_cn: 我妹妹很喜欢动物。

chunks.head: be absorbed in
chunks.note: 指注意力完全投入某事
chunks.ex_en: He was absorbed in his work and forgot the time.
chunks.ex_cn: 他专心工作,忘了时间。

chunks.head: take sth in hand
chunks.note: 指开始负责、管束某人或某事
chunks.ex_en: The new coach took the team in hand and turned it around.
chunks.ex_cn: 新教练接手了这支队伍,让它转败为胜。

chunks.head: put sth to rights
chunks.note: 指把凌乱的东西弄整齐、恢复正常
chunks.ex_en: It took her all morning to put the messy room to rights.
chunks.ex_cn: 她花了一上午才把凌乱的房间收拾整齐。
